verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any bulk or batch operation, such as batch transfers, bulk beneficiary creation, or bulk refunds. The CLI's ability to "script repeatable tasks" is only a building block a developer could use to construct bulk behavior, and AgentOS "multi-step financial workflows" are sequential workflows, not bulk actions across many items. The subscriptions "Multi-item" feature means billing several products on one subscription, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
